title: Heartbeat
blurb: Two slow lub-dub heartbeats, pitched low enough to feel in a subwoofer rather than merely hear. This is the oldest tension trick in audio: put a heartbeat under any footage and the audience's own pulse starts negotiating with it, which is why horror films have leaned on it for a century. Editors use it for suspense builds, jump-scare setups, and the specific moment before opening exam results. Synthesised around 55 Hz for real low-end weight, and it loops seamlessly if you need the dread sustained.
origin: Original low-frequency synthesis of a resting human heartbeat.
